Mobile App by Roland Sobrepena

P2MC | Price to My Currency

A quick visual reference for the P2MC app. You can get price into your preferred currency using camera, voice, or manual entry.

Main screen

Convert a price

Use the numbered callouts in the screenshot to identify each control.

  1. 1SettingsOpen currency configuration.
  2. 2Speak the phraseHear “How much is this?” in the selected price currency’s language.
  3. 3Price currencyThe currency of the amount being entered.
  4. 4Camera inputPhotograph a displayed price and place the recognized amount in the entry field.
  5. 5Voice inputPress and speak an amount to place it in the entry field.
  6. 6AmountEnter or edit the price to convert.
  7. 7Swap currenciesExchange the source and target currencies.
  8. 8Target currencyYour preferred currency for the converted result.
  9. 9Converted valueThe source amount expressed in the target currency.

Configuration

Choose your currencies

Select both currencies, review the exchange-rate timestamp, and apply the changes.

  1. 10Price currencySelect the currency shown on the price you want to convert.
  2. 11My currencySelect the currency in which you want to see the result.
  3. 12Last updatedShows when the app most recently downloaded exchange-rate information.
  4. 13Apply changesSave the selected currencies and return to the converter.
Helpful tip: Configure both currencies before entering a price. Use the camera and microphone for quicker entry.
